purpose: Indicate a matter connected to something significant.
keywords: We want to prevent life-threatening accidents.
This is a matter affecting the company’s credibility.
We carefully control documents relating to personal information.
restrictions: Often concerns important matters such as life, trust, rights, or reputation.
mistake: Not every minor connection warrants this weighty expression.
